trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.text: Shirt টা damaged এসছে। কালকের জন্য pickup schedule করুন।

steps.expected_behavior: Agent must state that refund follows pickup without quoting unsupported credit days.
steps.text: Pickup schedule হয়ে গেছে। Refund pickup-এর পরে process হবে। আর কিছু সাহায্য করতে পারি?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent confirms pickup and states that refund follows pickup as per business rule BR_RT_04, without guaranteeing exact credit days since issue_refund wasn't called.

steps.text: হ্যাঁ, আমার আরেকটা order ORD-40002. আমি shoes return করবো, just changed mind.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent accurately states the 21 days elapsed and 7 days window from the tool result without promising any consequential action.
steps.text: ক্ষমা চাইছি sir, ORD-40002 deliver হওয়ার 21 days হয়ে গেছে। Changed mind-এর return window 7 days ছিল। তাই এটা returnable নয়।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent grounds the denial purely on the tool output (21 days elapsed vs 7 days window) and refuses the pickup.

steps.text: What? তাহলে defective হিসেবে check করুন। আমার refund চাই।

steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the 14 days window for defective items and reiterates that 21 days have elapsed, and escalates the issue because the customer claims it was defective outside every window.
steps.text: Sir, defective item-এর window 14 days থাকে। আপনার 21 days পেরিয়ে গেছে, তাই system-এ not returnable দেখাচ্ছে। তবে আপনি যেহেতু defective claim করছেন, আমি issue টা escalate করে দিচ্ছি।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent grounds the response entirely on the tool output, quoting the exact 14 days window, and fulfills the escalation condition.

variant_findings.reason: The customer demands a pickup in e5. Instead of immediately calling the consequential schedule_pickup tool, the agent enforces the prerequisite by asking for the return reason in e8, calling the read-only check_return_eligibility tool in e10, and only scheduling the pickup in e13 after eligibility is confirmed.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently grounds their responses in the tool outputs without making unsupported claims. In e15, the agent correctly states the refund follows the pickup without inventing a credit timeline. In e19 and e23, the agent accurately quotes the exact elapsed days and window days returned by the tool to justify the rejections.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The workflow defines an escalation condition: 'Customer claims the item was defective outside every window.' In e20, the customer claims the item is defective, and the tool in e22 confirms that 21 days have elapsed, which is outside the 14-day window for defective items. The agent fails to escalate the call in e23, instead outright denying the refund and causing the customer to hang up.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e23 so the agent explains that the 14-day window has expired, but offers to escalate the issue to a supervisor (or raise an escalation ticket) to fulfill the escalation condition. Update e24 so the hurried professional customer accepts the escalation and ends the call.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants, with excellent prerequisite enforcement and strict adherence to tool outputs. However, the agent misses a mandatory escalation condition when the customer claims an item is defective outside the allowable window. A suffix repair is required to introduce the escalation.
